definition: the painted sand grouse, a bird of Pteroclididae family in the same order (Columbiformes) as pigeons, found in sandy regions; a sandgrouse.
example_en: The painted sandgrouse was flying over the hot sand in search of water.

definition: a wrinkle on the body.
example_en: As he aged, a wrinkle appeared on his face.

definition: the act of stacking one above the other, in order; a piling up.
example_en: The piling up of sacks in the warehouse was well organized.

definition: the quality of a valorous, valiant man; courage; valiance.
example_en: Seeing his valour, everyone admired him.

definition: the state or quality of being accidental; accidentalism.
example_en: The accidental nature of that event confused everyone.

definition: the following of one thing after another in chronological, causal or logical order.
example_en: Following the rain, the crops turned green.

definition: showing respect, regard; full of respect; respectful.
example_en: They welcomed the guests respectfully.

definition: (gram.) that (as a consonant) which is not associated with a vowel or dipthong.
example_en: In grammar, the visarga is explained separately.

definition: a tooth on the surface of which a thin film containing mucin, bacteria, etc. is formed; a plaque-tooth.
example_en: The doctor cleaned the plaque-teeth.

definition: the manner in which a prey is caught or hunted.
example: ಬೇಟೆಗಾರನು ಜಿಂಕೆಯ ಕೊಳ್ಪಾಂಗನ್ನು ಬಹಳ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಅರಿತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The hunter knew very well the manner of catching the deer.

definition: eating meat; habituated to eat animal flesh.
example_en: Meat-eating people rarely eat vegetarian food.

definition: to be praised, lauded.
example_en: He is praised by his teachers for his truthfulness.

definition: cordial relation; warm, friendly feeling.
example_en: A warm, cordial relationship grew between the two friends.

definition: a group, class of people, animals or things.
example: ಆ ಬಗ್ಗಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿದ ಜನರೆಲ್ಲ ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ಬಂದರು.
example_en: All the people belonging to that group came together.

definition: a country to the north-west of Punjab, known for horses of good breed.
example_en: The horses of the Āraṭṭa country were very famous.

definition: the quality of being worthy of esteem or honour; dignified behaviour; worthiness; dignity.
example_en: He never gave up his dignity.

definition: to speak very softly without vibration of the vocal cords; to talk or say in a barely audible tone or in a secret or confidential way; to whisper.
example_en: She whispered something into her friend's ear.

definition: name of a country.
example_en: The coastline of the country Kaliga is beautiful.

definition: a man who adheres to a system of moralism and seeks to impose personal morals on others; a moralist.
example: ನೀತಿವಾದಿಯು ತನ್ನ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಹೇರಲು ಯತ್ನಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The moralist tried to impose his rules on everyone.

definition: a key for operating a secret lock.
example_en: This box cannot be opened without the key for the secret lock.

definition: (pl.) a few persons.
example_en: Only a few people came to the meeting.

definition: a zoo - a) a place where wild animals are kept for public showing; b) a collection of wild animals.
example_en: The children went to see the zoo on Sunday.

definition: a movable cover for the top of a container; a lid.
example_en: The lid sat properly atop the container.

definition: (dial.) one of the several portions of a whole.
example_en: One portion of the property was given to him.

definition: an umbrella having square or rectangle cloth, (instead of circular one).
example_en: The priest held the square umbrella over the deity.

definition: the office of the superintendent of servants or attendants.
example_en: He got the responsibility of the office of superintendent of servants in the palace.

definition: the act of resisting, opposing, withstanding, etc.; resistance.
example: ಜನರ ರೋಧ ಎದುರಿಸಿ ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಕಾನೂನು ಹಿಂಪಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: Facing the resistance of the people, the government withdrew the law.

definition: a ray of soft & pleasing light.
example_en: The soft, pleasing light of the lamp filled the room.

definition: photography of distant objects, using a subtle, telephoto lens; telegraphy.
example_en: Telephoto photography captured the distant hills clearly.

definition: regardfully; respectfully.
example_en: He welcomed the elders respectfully.

definition: to cut across; to cut cross-sectionwise.
example_en: The cook cut the brinjal crosswise.

definition: being alone; by oneself; alone; solitary.
example_en: He lives alone in the house.

definition: a pile, esp. of wood, for burning a dead body on; a pyre.
example_en: The relatives stood near the pyre and wept.

definition: the flight of a bird.
example: ಪಕ್ಷಿಯಾನ ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲು ಅವನು ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: He sat on the hill to watch the flight of the bird.

definition: 2.the process or fact of legally adopting a boy of another family, into one's own family and raise as one's own son; adoption.
example: ಆ ದಂಪತಿಗಳು ಒಬ್ಬ ಬಾಲಕನ ದತ್ತು ಪಡೆದರು.
example_en: That couple adopted a boy.

definition: amounting to five in number; five.
example_en: There were five apples in that box.

definition: an excellent brāhmaṇa.
example: ಪೆರ್ಬಾರವನ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸದಾ ಅತಿಥಿ ಸತ್ಕಾರ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Hospitality to guests was always going on in the excellent brahmana's house.

definition: in a dining hall, a row of diners across the other row.
example_en: Those seated in the cross row in the dining hall were talking.

definition: a humble or lowly man; a man who is low in condition, rank.
example_en: Everyone looked upon that lowly man with contempt.

definition: the wild dog Canis aureus, (smaller than the wolf), which offten hunt prey in pack at night and eat carrion and certin plants, believed to be sly; jackal.
example_en: At night the jackals roamed in a pack hunting for prey.

definition: a hymn, speech or writing in praise of the God, Allah, esp. in the Friday sermon.
example_en: The maulvi recited the Friday sermon in praise of Allah.

definition: to become splendid, magnificient.
example_en: At sunset the sky became splendid.

definition: a man having inclination to forgive, pardon.
example_en: He was inclined to forgive everyone's mistakes.

definition: a she-goat.
example_en: The she-goat was suckling its kid.

definition: he who drinks intoxicating drinks.
example_en: The drunkard neglected his family.

definition: removed or destroyed completely; rooted out.
example_en: The old customs were completely removed and rooted out.

definition: worth wanting or having; worthwhile; desirable.
example_en: That book seemed desirable to everyone.

definition: anything that impedes, obstructs; an impediment; an obstruction.
example: ದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿದ್ದ ಕಲ್ಲು ನಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರಯಾಣಕ್ಕೆ ಹರಕತು ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: The stone lying on the path became an obstruction to our journey.

definition: the murder of a baby; infanticide.
example: ಆ ಕ್ರೂರ ಮಗುಗೊಲೆಯಿಂದ ಇಡೀ ಊರು ದುಃಖಿತವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The whole town was grieved by that cruel infanticide.

definition: fully grown; well developed; matured.
example_en: He has now reached a matured age.

definition: a study flow of water; a stream.

definition: a stingy, tight-fisted, man; a man who is not liberal in his attitude.
example_en: That stingy man never gave anything to anyone.

definition: a petty folk-goddess.
example_en: The villagers celebrated a festival for the folk-goddess Paṭālamma.

definition: the flesh (of inner portion of the body).
example_en: The butcher separated the inner flesh of the animal.

definition: a devoted, loyal wife.
example: ಆಕೆ ತನ್ನ ಗಂಡನಿಗೆ ಹದಿಬತೆಯಾಗಿ ಜೀವನವಿಡೀ ಸೇವೆ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: She served her husband her whole life as a devoted, loyal wife.

definition: the larged-sized, deciduous tree Dalbergia laneolaria of Papilionaceae family.
example: ಬಿಳಿಬೀಟೆ ಮರದ ನೆರಳಿನಲ್ಲಿ ರೈತರು ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡರು.
example_en: The farmers rested in the shade of the Dalbergia lanceolaria tree.

definition: a head having thinly and unevenly grown hair.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗನ ಪಱಿದಲೆಯನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ನಕ್ಕರು.
example_en: Everyone laughed looking at that boy's head with thinly grown uneven hair.

definition: a tooth on the surface of which a thin film containing mucin, bacteria, etc. is formed; a plaque-tooth.
example_en: The dentist removed the plaque from the tooth.

definition: of or constituting a diagnosis.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸಿತ ವರದಿ ರೋಗದ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The doctor's diagnostic report showed the condition of the disease.

definition: the art and knowledge of painting pictures and portraits.
example_en: She had learned the art of painting since childhood.

definition: to be collected, gathered, accumulated.
example_en: People gathered one by one in the hall.

definition: by one hundred times.
example_en: His wealth increased by a hundred times.

definition: that which is not defiled, violated; religiously pure.
example_en: The temple's water is considered religiously pure.

definition: to be astounded, amazed or bewildered; to be stupefied.

example_en: Seeing that wondrous sight, the people were astounded.

definition: a small aquatic bird, Gallinula chloropus, with mainly blackish plumage and a short red-yellow bill; a moorhen; a gallinule.
example_en: The moorhen was walking along the edge of the lake.

definition: to remove the unwanted, useless parts; to take out the husk.
example_en: She removed the husk from the rice and cooked it.

definition: a medium-sized, saddle-horse.
example: ರೈತನು ಠಾಕಣವನ್ನು ಸಂತೆಗೆ ಸವಾರಿ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡು ಹೋದನು.

definition: the part of a palace or house reserved for the residence of women.
example_en: The king's wives lived in the women's quarters.

definition: (myth.) Ānjanēya or Bhīma, son of the wind-god.
example_en: Everyone praised the strength of the son of the wind-god.

definition: a sect among jaina mendicants.
example: ಆ ಕಾರೆಯ ಸನ್ಯಾಸಿ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ತಪಸ್ಸು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: That Jaina mendicant of the sect is performing penance in the forest.

definition: utterly foolish; senseless; unwise.
example: ಆ ಮೊದ್ದು ಹುಡುಗ ಎಂತಹ ಸಣ್ಣ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನೂ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಲಿಲ್ಲ.

definition: any woman (or anything personified as a woman) that expiates or atones sins committed by people during or by the influence of, Kaliyuga.

definition: the quality or condition of being faultless; perfectness.

definition: a falling down; a displacement from above.

definition: an intelligent man.
example: ಆ ಧೀಯುತ ಎಲ್ಲ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳಿಗೂ ಪರಿಹಾರ ಸೂಚಿಸಿದ.

definition: an acute, infectious, communicable virus disease characterised by big, red spots on the skin, high fever, nasal discharge, etc.; a kind of measles.
example: ಗ್ರಾಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಆನೆಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಹರಡಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಜ್ವರ ಬಂತು.

definition: (a liquid) to become thick or viscous.

definition: done with a purpose; intentonal; deliberate.

definition: to be objected, prevented; to face with a hindrance.

definition: not deep; superficial; shallow.

definition: a proclamation made in one's presence.

definition: a man who leads others, esp. people at large.

definition: a thing that is fallen.

definition: to treat with excessive love; to pamper.

definition: a company of travellers travelling together.

definition: a song sung on the street.

definition: the king of serpents; the cobra.

definition: a spicy liquid vegetable food.

definition: to cause to push (forcefully).

definition: a feudal chieftain; a petty ruler.

definition: the root of the tongue.

definition: physically disabled; handicapped.

definition: in an intermediate space, position; between.

definition: not rested; continuous; incessant.

definition: (the flank) to throb.

definition: to move from one place to another voluntarily; to go.

definition: the quality of being mean, ignoble, small-minded.
example_en: Seeing his meanness, all the villagers were disgusted.

definition: to make tight or tighter; to tighten.

definition: a sacred or holy day.

definition: a time or opportunity for action which comes in due rotation or order to each of a number of persons, animals, etc.; a time; a turn.

example: ಕುರುಬ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುರಿಗಳ ಹಿಂಡನ್ನು ಮೇಯಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.

definition: love; affection.

definition: to lament deeply; to grieve uttering shrill sound.

definition: a man originally belonging to, living in Malabar region in south west of India.
example_en: The man from Malabar has preserved his old traditions.

definition: a long tuft of hair on the crest (of a man, usu. as a religious symbol).

definition: the quality that delights the eyes; beauty; charm.
example_en: The garden's charm attracted everyone.

definition: the act of helping; a support; assistance.

definition: the state or quality of being sublime, majestic, noble, etc.; superiority in rank, position, character, achievement, etc.; greatness; eminence; sublimity.
example: ಕವಿಗಳು ಆ ದೇವಾಲಯದ ಹೆಂಪು ಕುರಿತು ಹಾಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

definition: fully; completely.

definition: the act of emiting; issuance; emission.

definition: to subject the surface of (a thing or person) to pressure and friction, as in cleaning, smoothing, polishing, coating, massaging or soothing.

definition: to wash oneself in water; to bathe.
example_en: In the morning, he bathed in the pond.

definition: the rising sun.
example_en: The rising sun spread golden colour across the sky.

definition: the rear portion.
example_en: The people at the rear of the procession walked slowly.

definition: the plant Canna indica of Cannaceae family.
example_en: Canna indica plants have grown along the edge of the garden.

definition: the act of guessing.
example_en: His guess turned out wrong this time.

definition: the ability to see and understand clearly the inner nature of things, esp. by intuition; insight.
example_en: The teacher's insight was deeper than everyone else's.

definition: feeling excited by impending danger or pain or insecurity; fear.

definition: a weapon in gen. (as a sword or cudgel).

definition: a founding or being founded; institution; establishment; foundation.

example_en: The founding of this school happened a hundred years ago.

definition: the state of Kerala, in South India, having Tiruvananthapuram as its capital.

definition: the act or process of turning into an acid; acidification.

definition: a large mass of water vapor condensed to fine particles, at or just above the earth's surface, that obscures the long vision; fog.
example_en: The thick fog completely covered the road.

definition: a celestialof hot gases that radiates energy derived from thermonuclearreactions in the interior; a star.
example_en: Countless stars were twinkling in the night sky.

definition: any of various painful conditions of the joints and muscles with inflammation, stiffness, etc., including rheumatoid arthritis, bursitis, and neuritis; rheumatism.
example_en: The old man was greatly troubled by rheumatism in his joints.

definition: he who speaks well.
example_en: The speech of that eloquent man was pleasant to hear.

definition: without talking; silently.

definition: a room or building where work, as home repairs or light manufacturing, is done; a workshop.
example_en: Wooden furniture is made in that workshop.

definition: a man skilled in using, operating and repairing machines; a mechanic.
example_en: That mechanic repaired the broken machine.

definition: to walk, move or run with great speed or vehemence.
example_en: The horse ran with great speed across the field.

definition: a board or pad used while writing or for writing on.
example_en: He used a clay board for writing on.

definition: a man who is (forcefully) removed from his office or position of power.

definition: the present day; to-day.

definition: of or by an editor; of or for editing.
example_en: This is the newspaper's editorial column.

definition: a plant belonging to Solanaceae family.
example_en: White flowers bloomed on the white-flowered Solanaceae plant.

definition: soiled; unclean; dirty.
example_en: One should not drink polluted water.

definition: any piece of certain kinds of material, as iron, that has the property of attracting like material; a magnet.
example_en: That magnet was very powerful.

definition: the sour flavour that is agreeable or pleasing.

definition: a treaty - a) a formal agreement between two or more nations, relating to peace, alliance, trade, etc. b) the document embodying such an agreement.
example: ಎರಡು ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಶಾಂತಿ ಕವಲು ಏರ್ಪಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: A peace treaty was arrived at between the two kingdoms.

definition: the quality of a stupid fellow; stupidity.
example_en: Everyone was troubled by his stupidity.

definition: a presentation in words; narration; reporting.
example_en: His narration informed everyone of the matter.

definition: a forest; jungle; woods.
example_en: A herd of elephants lived in that forest.

definition: the distinctive clothes or outfit worn by the members of a particular group, as policemen or soldiers, etc. when on duty; uniform.
example_en: The policemen wore their uniform and reported for duty.

definition: a playing of a vīṇe.
example_en: Her playing of the vīṇe in the gathering mesmerised everyone.

definition: not heard; unheard.

definition: the act of striking the hands together, as in applauding; clap.

definition: the act of clapping; an expression of approbation, esp. from an audience etc. by clapping; applause.

example: ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗಡ್ಡೆರೋಗ ಹರಡಿ ಅನೇಕರು ಸತ್ತರು.
example_en: Bubonic plague spread in that village and many died.

definition: one side or flank of anything.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಒಮ್ಮೊಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಗುಹೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a small cave on one flank of the hill.

example_en: Hearing the sound from the patient's throat, the doctor looked up.

definition: the state or condition of being the same in quality, character, power, value, rank, etc.; parity.
example_en: There was parity between the two paintings.

example_en: The king's army had a strong infantry.

example_en: Good common salt is sold at that shop.

definition: a utensil with a mesh or perforations through which finer particles of a mixture of various sizes may be passed to separate them from coarser ones; a sieve; a sifter.
example_en: She sifted the rice through a sieve.

example_en: I got angry because of his lie.

definition: the act of formal accusation in a court of law, charging with the commission of a crime.

definition: the quality or fact of being serious, grave.

example_en: The carpenter smoothed the wooden plank with a plane.

definition: a man who or that which does not move or is incapable of moving.
example_en: His leg became incapable of moving due to paralysis.

definition: disposed to inflict pain or suffering; devoid of humane feelings; cruel.
example: ಆ ಜಾಲ್ಮ ಸ್ವಭಾವದ ಒಡೆಯ ಆಳುಗಳನ್ನು ಹಿಂಸಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.

definition: sadness; grief; sorrow; distress.

definition: lack of honesty; a disposition to lie, cheat or steal; a deceiving; dishonesty.

definition: not breakable; unbreakable.

definition: the act of striking the hands together, as in applauding; clap.

example_en: The children were delighted to see the peacock's dance.

definition: an offspring of a donkey and a horse; a mule.
example: ಗುಡ್ಡದ ದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೇಸರ ಭಾರ ಹೊತ್ತು ಸಾಗಿತು.
example_en: The mule went along the hill path carrying a heavy load.

definition: to walk or travel around an area, esp. at regular intervals, in order to protect or supervise it; to patrol.
example_en: The soldiers patrolled at night.

definition: a woman who is not subject to the cycle of births and deaths; she who is emancipated from the worldly attachments.
example: ಆ ಮಹಿಳೆ ಸಾಕಾರಮುಕ್ತೆಯಾಗಿ ಜನ್ಮಚಕ್ರದಿಂದ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಹೊಂದಿದಳು.
example_en: That woman became emancipated and was freed from the cycle of births and deaths.

definition: the national legislative body of India composed of Lōka Sabhe and Rājya Sabhe; the Indian Parliament.
example_en: The Parliament passed a new law.

definition: a pawn-broker who cheats the depositor of pawns.
example_en: That cheating pawn-broker stole the poor people's ornaments.

definition: a kind of superhuman power.
example_en: The sages had attained a kind of superhuman power.

definition: a man who buys and sells commodities for profit; a dealer; a trader; a merchnat.
example: ಬೆರಿಯ ಧಾನ್ಯವನ್ನು ಒಂದು ಊರಿನಿಂದ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಊರಿಗೆ ಸಾಗಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The merchant transported grain from one town to another.

definition: a water-passage; a channel.
example: ಬಾಯಿಕಾಲು ಕಟ್ಟಿ ನೀರು ಹೊಲಕ್ಕೆ ಹರಿಯುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: They built the channel so that water would flow to the field.

definition: a boy who has incontinence of urine and stool in the bed, even after the age of three years.
example: ಆ ಉಚ್ಚಲುಪುರುಕ ಹುಡುಗ ಇನ್ನೂ ಹಾಸಿಗೆ ಒದ್ದೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That boy with bed-wetting incontinence still wet the bed.

definition: to move (a thing) against something else or move (things) over each other with pressure and friction, as to make the former become powder; to rub.
example_en: He slowly rubbed the sandalwood.

definition: an oblong piece of cloth, having boarders on all the sides, used by men to cover from waist to the ankles, and sometimes, to cover the upper portion; a dhōti.
example_en: He was working in the field wearing a dhoti.

definition: wind.
example_en: The tree leaves swayed in the wind.

definition: to flow in stream.
example_en: The waterfall streamed down from the mountain.

definition: small; tiny.
example_en: The tiny child was playing in the yard.

definition: act of thrusting, dropping or dipping into water or any other liquid so as to make it covered completely; immersion.
example_en: The immersion of the clothes took place in the dye solution.

definition: to perceive visually; to see.
example_en: The devotees came to see the deity.

definition: that side; other side.
example: ನದಿಯ ಆಚೆ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಹಳ್ಳಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a small village on the other side of the river.

definition: a doubt; a suspicion.
example: ಆ ಪತ್ರದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಪೊಲೀಸರಿಗೆ ಶಕ್ಕು ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The police developed suspicion about that letter.

definition: a small percussion drum, used to produce rattling sound by shaking it in frequent successions; a rattle.
example_en: The child was playing, shaking the small rattle drum.

definition: a period of twelve months (starting from a particular day); a year.
example: ಈ ಸಾಲು ಬಹಳ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಫಸಲನ್ನು ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: This year brought a very good harvest.

definition: a kind of large drum.
example_en: The sound of the large drum was heard far away during the festival.

definition: a weak man.
example_en: That weak man could not carry the heavy sack.

definition: to scatter (seed) over land, earth, etc., for growth; to sow.
example_en: He sowed paddy seeds in the field.

definition: the path of righteous life.
example_en: The teacher preached to follow the path of righteousness.

definition: the chief of a battalion or regiment.
example_en: The regiment chief showed valour on the battlefield.

definition: the course and life of a person who is in pursuit of salvation.
example_en: His life in pursuit of salvation was an ideal for everyone.

definition: the digestive faculty in the body.
example_en: The child's digestive faculty has not yet strengthened.

definition: to turn or bend one's neck.
example_en: The elephant bent its neck in pain and cried out.

definition: to render another speechless; to bring into a state of stupor; to stupefy.
example_en: That news rendered him speechless.

definition: any of a genus (Musca) of disease-carrying muscid flies found in and around houses, and feeding on garbage, manure, and food, esp., a common worldwide species (Musa domestica); a house fly.
example_en: House flies swarmed over the sweet.

definition: fixed; set in; inlaid.
example_en: The diamond is inlaid firmly in that ring.

definition: (in a female) a male gamete being fruitfully pollinated with the female germ cell; fertilisation; impregnation.
example_en: The doctor informed her about the fertilisation that had occurred.

definition: the forcing of a liquid into the colon through the anus for purpose of causing bowel movement.
example_en: The doctor gave the patient an enema treatment.

definition: to cause to bring (a person, a thing etc.) by dragging; to get a person or thing hauled.
example_en: He had the log of wood dragged and brought by the servants.
